aggregators.name: Basic Concat
aggregators.description: Joins the most recent alerts into one record, with their IDs and timestamps.

aggregators.name: LogID Count
aggregators.description: Counts how often each log ID appears in alerts and reports the ones past a threshold.

aggregators.name: Time Delta
aggregators.description: Groups alerts that arrive close together in time (Landauer et al.).

aggregators.name: AlertBERT
aggregators.description: Groups alerts by time and by masked-language-model embeddings of them (Karner et al.).
